summary: Stevanato Group S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching the script for its Q1 2026 earnings conference call held on May 7, 2026. The filing notes a temporary change due to CEO Franco Stevanato recovering from an appendectomy, with CFO Marco Dal Lago leading the call. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, or management change is announced. The call discusses quarterly financial results, revenue growth, and operational updates. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
